semantic_families.intent_template: Current-cast numeric relation output contrasted with an explicit literary explanation.
Cast serialization paired with a separately requested void-line explanation.
Restatement is distinguished from a separately requested interpretation and incidental labels.
Quote-only output and prediction bans remain separate from source retrieval.
Local exclusions and the two-topic cap on a cast with multiple reviewed relations.
A missing current relation does not block an independently scoped theory question.
Named but source-checked concepts remain requestable and unselectable.
Exclusive output conflicts with literature; sequential tasks do not.
Aggregate cast data as an index versus separately request a source explanation.
Source citation or quotation contrasted with a present/absent label lookup.
Roman-numeral line indexing exposes exclusive versus sequential source requests.
Incidental source-checked annotation contrasted with an explicit request about it.
A concept may be requested in theory, in the cast, or in both contexts.
Postposed and prefixed exclusions remain local to their named concepts.
Missing current anchor and source-checked literature are distinct rejection reasons.
Typos and theory/case ambiguity are separate from a safe two-topic comparison.
